acceptance_checks.given: a post declaring a `type` from the themed vocabulary
acceptance_checks.then: the post layout SHALL display a visible post-type badge matching that declared type
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a post with `type: cantrip` renders a badge labeled for the cantrip type in `_site`

acceptance_checks.given: a post that sets the optional epistemic-status (`assay`) field
acceptance_checks.then: the layout SHALL display the declared epistemic-status label
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a post with `assay: speculative` renders the speculative label in `_site`

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish a reader-contract page stating the right-to-be-wrong or living-document terms for the journal
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a terms or contract page renders and states the correction or revision policy

acceptance_checks.then: every page SHALL carry a sitewide "opinions are my own, not my employer's" disclaimer in the global footer
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the disclaimer string appears in the shared footer include of every rendered page

acceptance_checks.when: the research-dump ("transmutation") post-type is applied to it
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL render with a post-type badge visibly distinct from the handcrafted "scroll" essays
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the post's rendered badge label differs from a scroll post's badge label

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL provide a cadence-anchor stream ("Alchemist's Log") with its own index or tag aggregation page
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a log index or tag page renders and lists the log-type entries

acceptance_checks.given: a visitor whose operating system reports a dark colour-scheme preference
acceptance_checks.when: any page is loaded with JavaScript disabled
acceptance_checks.then: the page SHALL render in the dark theme via `prefers-color-scheme`
acceptance_checks.verify_method: JS-disabled render with `prefers-color-scheme: dark` emulated shows the dark theme background token on every page, not only post pages
